extension.description: Capture what you did and its impact from VS Code: selected code, the current file or the last commit. Drafts open in your impact log — nothing is sent to a server.
config.appUrl: Address of your impact log. Drafts open at `<address>/capture`. Only `https://` (or `http://localhost…` for development, e.g. `http://localhost:5173`). User setting only: workspaces can't override it.
config.defaultScore: Impact preselected when capturing (1 — small win … 5 — key result of the year).
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode git is not used: no links to commits, branches and files.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: In virtual workspaces git is not available: no links to commits, branches and files.
